name: CGB
recent: Central Global Berhad 近期有多项企业活动：委任 Ong Shiow Yee 为首席财务官，并因凭单转换而发行新股。同时，董事与大股东在闭市期内外有多次买卖申报。
notable: 委任 Ong Shiow Yee 为首席财务官，2026 年 11 月 11 日生效。
因凭单 B 转换而发行 890,400 股新股，上市日期为 2026 年 11 月 26 日。
risks: 集团执行董事 Lee Chee Vui 在闭市期内外有多次股份出售申报。
集团董事总经理 Chew Hian Tat 在闭市期内外有股份出售申报。
HJT International Group (M) Sdn. Bhd. 申报不再是大股东。
earnings: 最近一季（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 98.18 million，环比增长 27.3%；净利为 MYR 3.02 million，环比下降 22.4%；净利率从 5.0% 降至 3.1%。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from warrant conversion

recent_en: Central Global Berhad has seen several corporate developments recently: it proposed a RM500 million Sukuk Mudharabah programme, appointed Ong Shiow Yee as CFO, and issued new shares from warrant conversion. Meanwhile, directors and substantial shareholders reported multiple dealings during and around the closed period.
notable_en: Proposed a RM500 million Sukuk Mudharabah programme.
Appointed Ong Shiow Yee as Chief Financial Officer effective 11 November 2026.
Issued 890,400 new shares from conversion of Warrants B, with listing date on 26 November 2026.
risks_en: Group Executive Director Lee Chee Vui reported multiple share disposals during and around the closed period.
Group Managing Director Chew Hian Tat reported share disposals during and around the closed period.
HJT International Group (M) Sdn. Bhd. ceased to be a substantial shareholder.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2025, revenue was MYR 98.18 million, up 27.3% QoQ; net income was MYR 3.02 million, down 22.4% QoQ; net margin fell from 5.0% to 3.1%.
